metadata.case_name: KONG LIN FAT JOHNNY v. THE INCORPORATED OWNERS OF CHANG PAO CHING BUILDING AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Proprietor of his own travel agency business

injuries.description: a minor sprain of the right trapezius muscle which was caused by the sudden stop of the lift.
source: a minor sprain of the right trapezius muscle which was caused by the sudden stop of the lift.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of other specified muscle, fascia, tendon or bursa at shoulder or upper arm level

injuries.description: the contusion of the right heel
source: The contusion of the right heel was due to his kicking on the lift door.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other or unspecified parts of foot

source: the plaintiff actually suffered from Adjustment Disorder and the Accident is the direct cause of the plaintiff’s psychiatric injury of Adjustment Disorder.

manifestations.description: mild tenderness over the right trapezius muscle
pain related to right heel/ankle contusion
fear and phobia about travelling by lift (avoidance/need for accompaniment)
nightmares about lift accidents or falling from height
poor concentration and poor memory affecting work performance
suicidal attempt by drug overdose (6 November 2008)
cessation of sporting activities (football, running, table tennis, swimming)
difficulty speaking fluently (reported after taking drugs)

treatments_received: Accident & Emergency treatment at Ruttonjee & Tang Shiu Kin Hospital (18 March 2008)
psychiatric consultations at Prince of Wales Hospital and North District Hospital
admission to Acute Integrated Unit (6-7 November 2008)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: ceased football, running, table tennis and swimming after the Accident

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: complained of decreased sex drive after the Accident
poor concentration and memory; difficulty organizing work and making travel arrangements for clients

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: fear and phobia about taking lifts; needed accompaniment when taking lifts
frequent quarrels with his wife and interpersonal difficulties after the Accident
the plaintiff actually suffered from Adjustment Disorder and the Accident is the direct cause of the plaintiff’s psychiatric injury of Adjustment Disorder.
